item.title: Iranian drill simulates US invasion near Tehran
item.description:
The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps staged a five-day exercise near Tehran simulating an American ground invasion, practicing drone strikes and sniper fire – but the IRGC's only real ground encounter with US forces on Iranian soil ended in an embarrassing failure.

item.description:
